column1: # SwingViewportBench list (JList, 10^6 DefaultListModel strings, renderer heights 18), re-run 2026-10-19 06:39-06:53 with output on S: (the first run wrote to G:, which had failing writes), JDK 21.0.9 stock vs stock + patch with -Dm3.swing.viewport=true (leaf 3 hook), -XX:+UseSerialGC -Xms64m -Xmx1500m, headless, three rounds (stock first twice, M3 first once); machine heavily shared: commit headroom fell to 2.6 GB during round 1, and single-shot rows (model_build, preferred_size, insert_first_relayout) vary with load and GC even where no M3 code runs
